translations.push.guideIntro: In the Apple Developer account, open Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles → Keys. Follow
translations.push.guideStep1: Click +, give the key a name, select Apple Push Notification service, then choose Configure.
translations.push.guideStep2: Choose the environment(s) and key type. For a topic-specific key, include the app id of the client app (like defined here).
translations.push.guideStep3: Confirm and download the .p8 file. Apple only lets you download the private key once; store it securely.
translations.push.guideStep4: Copy the Key ID shown for the key and your Team ID from the developer account. Upload the .p8 below, fill in both IDs and the app topic, then enable and save.
translations.push.guideCertificateNote: An APNs .cer certificate cannot be converted to the .p8 token key this server expects. Create a key under Keys instead.
